stories.title: Philpot-Ford matchup an intriguing one in Grey Cup
stories.summary: Football is a game of matchups, and the Grey Cup on Sunday will present no shortage of them.

stories.title: Russia says it’ll demand compensation if barred from World Juniors in Alberta
stories.summary: Russian hockey federation president Vladislav Tretiak also threatened to push for the tournaments to be moved and seek sanctions against organizers.

stories.title: Alberta man, 19, accused of luring B.C. girl via Roblox and Snapchat
stories.summary: Police say the accused allegedly first made contact with the underage girl in B.C. on the online gaming platform Roblox before they began exchanging messages on Snapchat.

stories.title: Alberta expanding use of AI tech that speeds up MRIs after successful pilot
stories.summary: The Alberta government says the artificial intelligence technology is installed directly in MRI machines and improves image clarity while also shortening examination times.

stories.title: Most western Canadians say ditching time change was the ‘right move’: poll
stories.summary: After B.C., Alberta and Manitoba ditched the time change this fall, an Angus Reid Institute poll delved into how residents are reacting.

stories.title: Jarry continues strong goaltending for Oilers
stories.summary: Don't look now, but the Edmonton Oilers suddenly have good goaltending to go along with their potent offensive attack.

stories.title: Korpisalo sets tone for Rangers in win over Flames
stories.summary: Joonas Korpisalo came up big for the New York Rangers on Wednesday making 29 saves. But one was bigger than the rest.

stories.title: Bouchard nets OT winner, Oilers top Flyers 3-2
stories.summary: Evan Bouchard scored the game-winning goal 47 seconds into overtime as the Edmonton Oilers won their third game in a row, getting past the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Wednesday.

stories.title: Zibanejad scores twice, Rangers beat Flames 3-1
stories.summary: Mika Zibanejad scored twice in the second period on Wednesday to lead the New York Rangers to a 3-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: Mark Kilam ‘where I’m supposed to be’ as Edmonton Elks head coach
stories.summary: Mark Kilam admits he's sentimental about his first Grey Cup as a head coach in a city he called home for 20 years — but it pales compared to his pride over Edmonton's resurgence.
